item.description:
### 新功能
- **標題列視窗手勢**：游標放在標題列上用兩指滑動，就能貼齊半邊、1/3、四分之一，也能最大化、置頂、最小化、全螢幕 - 設定新增「教學」頁，一分鐘學會所有手勢 - 可以關掉手勢提示文字，只留圖示
### 改進
- 設定裡清楚標示哪些是完整版功能 - 左右滑切換 App 永遠免費
### New
- **Titlebar window gestures**: put the pointer on a titlebar and swipe with two fingers to snap to halves, thirds or quarters, or to maximize, pin, minimize and go full screen - A new Tutorial tab teaches every gesture in a minute - Gesture hints can now show just the icon, without text
### Improved
- Settings now mark which features are part of Pro - Swiping between apps is always free
